title: Shepherd: Enabling Programmable Meta-Agents via Reversible Agentic Execution Traces
authors_zh: Simon Yu, Derek Chong, Ananjan Nandi, Dilara Soylu, Jiuding Sun, Christopher D Manning, Weiyan Shi
paper_type_zh: 可逆智能体执行底座、元智能体框架与树式强化学习构造方法
best_for_zh: 研究环境交互轨迹、长程智能体强化学习、反事实回放、可复现性与安全审计的读者
one_line: Shepherd turns agent execution into a reversible Git-like trace and uses meta-agent-selected forks for Tree-GRPO, while leaving generated trajectories, checkpoints, splits, and data-governance artifacts unreleased.
Shepherd 将智能体动作、工具调用与耦合沙箱状态写成可逆的 Git 式执行轨迹，并以元智能体选点分支构造 Tree-GRPO 监督；但生成轨迹、模型检查点、精确划分和数据治理材料尚未发布。
why: It exposes the state, action, environment, branch, and reward relationships needed for auditable long-horizon agent supervision, while showing that rollback guarantees and dataset release guarantees are separate questions.
inclusion_reason: Shepherd makes the coupled agent-environment execution history a first-class data object and demonstrates how reversible typed traces, branch-local outcome rewards, and two-level credit assignment can construct agent-RL supervision without flattening away environment state.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Long-horizon agents do not only emit text. They call models and tools, mutate files and processes, and leave an environment whose state influences every later decision. Flat transcripts omit this coupled state, while coarse container snapshots do not expose which action caused a change. This makes it hard for a higher-order agent to observe a worker without perturbing it, stop a risky action before it materializes, branch at the point of failure, or reuse an unaffected prefix.

Shepherd treats execution itself as the object. A task is a typed agent definition; each action becomes an intent effect followed by an outcome effect; a scope binds the worker to model providers, tools, processes, filesystem state, and an effect cursor; and a persistent commit graph records the resulting history. The resulting record is not just a chat log: it joins action semantics, environment state, branch lineage, and task feedback.

For this atlas, the most important case is Meta-Agent-Guided Tree-RL. The authors start from a 2,492-task Endless Terminals pool, screen it with eight base-policy rollouts per task, and train on model-specific subsets after removing tasks passed by all eight rollouts: 442 tasks for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and 530 for Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B. Terminal-Bench 2.0 is held out as an out-of-distribution test set. No generated trajectory dataset or record-level task manifest is released, so Shepherd is primarily an environment/trace substrate and construction recipe rather than a downloadable training corpus.

长程智能体并非只输出文本。它们会调用模型与工具、修改文件和进程，并留下影响后续决策的环境状态。扁平对话记录会遗漏这种耦合状态，而粗粒度容器快照又无法说明哪个动作造成了变化。因此，高阶智能体很难在不扰动工作智能体的前提下进行观察，也难以在危险动作真正发生之前叫停、从失败点分支，或复用未受影响的前缀。

Shepherd 把执行本身当作数据对象。Task 是带类型的智能体定义；每个动作先形成意图 effect，再形成结果 effect；Scope 将工作智能体与模型提供方、工具、进程、文件系统状态和 effect 游标绑定；持久化提交图记录由此产生的历史。该记录不是普通聊天日志，而是把动作语义、环境状态、分支谱系与任务反馈连接起来。

对本图谱而言，最重要的案例是 Meta-Agent-Guided Tree-RL。作者从含 2,492 个任务的 Endless Terminals 池开始，每个任务用基础策略采样 8 条 rollout，并删除 8 条全部通过的任务；Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 与 Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B 分别留下 442 和 530 个任务。Terminal-Bench 2.0 被留作分布外测试集。论文没有发布生成轨迹数据集或逐条任务清单，因此 Shepherd 首先是环境/轨迹底座与构造方法，而非可下载训练语料。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Shepherd maps four agent-runtime concepts to functional-programming abstractions. A Task is a typed function and makes an agent substitutable. An Effect is a typed action record and separates intent from outcome. A Scope is a region-scoped handler that owns bindings and emitted effects. A Trace is a persistent Git-like graph in which effects become commits, forks become branches, accepted children can merge, and rejected children can be discarded.

The separation between intent and outcome is the feedback boundary. A supervisor can inspect an intent before the outside world responds and deny a destructive call before an outcome is materialized. Once executed, effects have one of three rollback contracts: reversible effects such as captured filesystem and sandbox state roll back natively; compensable effects such as some database writes require user-supplied compensation handlers; irreversible effects such as model calls and emails remain only as audit records. “Reversible execution” therefore does not mean that every external consequence can be undone.

Tree-GRPO uses the trace graph as a data-construction primitive. It keeps a root prefix, asks a stronger meta-agent to choose a fork turn and propose a bash action, restores the coupled agent-environment state just before that turn, and samples isolated sibling suffixes. Terminal outcome rewards are converted into two credit signals: inter-root GRPO advantage for shared-prefix actions and an intra-tree sibling advantage for post-fork actions. No learned value function or process-reward model is used.

Shepherd 将四个智能体运行时概念映射到函数式编程抽象。Task 是带类型的函数，使智能体可替换；Effect 是带类型的动作记录，并把意图与结果分开；Scope 是拥有绑定和所发 effects 的区域作用域处理器；Trace 是持久化 Git 式图，其中 effect 对应提交、fork 对应分支、被接受的子分支可 merge、被拒绝的子分支可 discard。

意图与结果分离构成反馈边界。监督智能体可以在外部世界响应之前查看意图，并在破坏性调用产生结果之前拒绝它。执行后的 effect 具有三类回滚契约：文件系统与沙箱状态等可逆 effect 可由底座原生回滚；某些数据库写入等可补偿 effect 依赖用户提供的补偿处理器；模型调用和电子邮件等不可逆 effect 只能保留为审计记录。因此，“可逆执行”并不意味着所有外部后果都能撤销。

Tree-GRPO 把轨迹图当作数据构造原语。它保留根轨迹前缀，让更强的元智能体选择 fork 回合并提出一个 bash 动作，恢复到该回合之前的耦合智能体—环境状态，再采样相互隔离的 sibling 后缀。终局结果奖励被转换为两类信用信号：共享前缀动作使用跨根 GRPO advantage，fork 后动作使用树内 sibling advantage；系统不使用学习得到的 value function 或过程奖励模型。

title: Method
方法
html:
The Tree-GRPO construction and training path is:

  1. Start from the 2,492-task Endless Terminals pool. For each base model, sample eight base-policy rollouts per task and remove tasks with pass@8=1.0. This yields 442 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B tasks and 530 Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B tasks.
  2. Sample a training batch of 16 prompts. Generate eight root rollouts per prompt in fresh sandboxes, for 128 root rollouts per step. Each rollout is capped at 8 turns, 1,024 generated tokens per turn, and 16,384 input tokens; SkyRL overlong filtering drops trajectories exceeding these caps.
  3. Record worker actions as immutable intent/outcome effects. Each scope binds the model provider, tools, processes, filesystem, sandbox handles, and trace cursor. Effects materialize as commits in a persistent branch graph.
  4. Give Claude Opus 4.7 the worker transcript and terminal reward. The meta-agent selects a prior turn and proposes the bash action it would take there. The action is rendered through the worker policy so its tokens match the worker action format.
  5. Roll the scope back to immediately before the chosen turn. Keep the prefix shared, create isolated child scopes, and sample sibling suffixes. A discarded child leaves the parent unchanged; a selected child can be merged.
  6. Score completed roots and siblings with the task-specific terminal outcome reward. Prefix actions use the inter-root group baseline; suffix actions use an intra-tree sibling baseline, localizing credit after the fork.
  7. Pool the advantages and update the policy with clipped GRPO. The disclosed setup runs on Modal-managed 8-H100 nodes with FSDP2, gradient checkpointing, torch.compile, Adam, weight decay 0.01, max-norm 0.1, a 20-step warm-up, no KL loss, ten epochs, and 1,120 total steps. Checkpoints and validation are taken every 10 steps; the rendered HTML omits the numeric learning rate.

The official shepherd-experiments repository provides the Tree-GRPO code, the other paper applications, microbenchmarks, and a frozen substrate snapshot. It does not provide a generated trajectory corpus, trained checkpoint, task-ID split manifest, or immutable release tag.

Tree-GRPO 的构造与训练流程如下：

  1. 从 2,492 个 Endless Terminals 任务开始。对每个基础模型，每个任务采样 8 条基础策略 rollout，并删除 pass@8=1.0 的任务；Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 与 Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B 分别留下 442 和 530 个任务。
  2. 每个训练步采样 16 个 prompt，每个 prompt 在新沙箱中生成 8 条根 rollout，共 128 条。每条 rollout 上限为 8 turns、每 turn 1,024 个生成 token、16,384 个输入 token；SkyRL 的 overlong filtering 会删除超过上限的轨迹。
  3. 将工作智能体动作记录为不可变的意图/结果 effects。每个 scope 绑定模型提供方、工具、进程、文件系统、沙箱句柄和轨迹游标；effects 在持久分支图中实体化为提交。
  4. 将工作智能体 transcript 与终局奖励交给 Claude Opus 4.7。元智能体选择一个先前回合，并提出它会在该处执行的 bash 动作；该动作经工作策略的 renderer 重渲染，以匹配工作智能体动作格式。
  5. 将 scope 回滚到所选回合之前。保留共享前缀，创建隔离的子 scope，并采样 sibling 后缀。discard 子分支不会改变父分支，被选中的子分支可以 merge。
  6. 用任务特定的终局结果奖励对根与 siblings 评分。前缀动作使用跨根 group baseline，后缀动作使用树内 sibling baseline，从而在 fork 之后定位信用。
  7. 汇总 advantages，并以 clipped GRPO 更新策略。披露配置运行在 Modal 管理的 8-H100 节点上，使用 FSDP2、gradient checkpointing、torch.compile、Adam、0.01 weight decay、0.1 max-norm、20-step warm-up、无 KL loss、10 个 epoch 和总计 1,120 steps。每 10 steps 保存 checkpoint 并验证；渲染后的 HTML 漏掉了学习率数值。

官方 shepherd-experiments 仓库提供 Tree-GRPO 代码、论文其他应用、微基准和冻结底座快照，但不提供生成轨迹语料、训练检查点、任务 ID 划分清单或不可变 release tag。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports three proof-of-existence applications. On CooperBench, a supervisor over parallel coding workers raises pair-coding pass rate from 28.8% to 54.7%. Counterfactual Replay Optimization edits workflows and replays only the affected suffix; the abstract reports a 12.8% advantage over MetaHarness on Terminal-Bench 2.0 with 58% lower wall-clock. These results demonstrate runtime intervention and prefix reuse, but they are not evidence of a reusable trajectory release.

For the training application, Table 5 evaluates held-out Terminal-Bench 2.0 on 89 tasks with five seeds. Qwen3.5-35B-A3B scores 26.1%±4.21 at base, 34.2%±4.05 with Flat GRPO, and 39.4%±3.87 with Tree-GRPO. Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B scores 30.3%±3.62 at base, 33.8%±3.41 with Flat GRPO, and 37.2%±3.19 with Tree-GRPO. Thus Tree-GRPO adds 5.2 points over Flat GRPO for Qwen3.5 and 3.4 points for Nemotron-3 under the reported setup.

The substrate evaluation supports a narrower reset claim. Fork and revert operate on captured copy-on-write state; a mutation-size sweep reports 12/12 successful checks in which the post-revert workdir matched the pre-fork state. Fork latency stays around 134–143 ms in the main benchmark and roughly 340 ms in a Mac/Docker Desktop sweep. These measurements support captured filesystem/sandbox rollback, not rollback of arbitrary external services or irreversible calls.

论文报告了三个概念验证式应用。在 CooperBench 上，监督智能体将并行编码智能体的 pair-coding 通过率从 28.8% 提高到 54.7%。Counterfactual Replay Optimization 编辑工作流并只回放受影响的后缀；摘要报告其在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上比 MetaHarness 高 12.8%，同时 wall-clock 降低 58%。这些结果证明运行时干预与前缀复用可行，但不能证明存在可复用的轨迹发布。

训练实验的 Table 5 在 89 个 held-out Terminal-Bench 2.0 任务上以 5 个 seeds 评测。Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 的 Base、Flat GRPO 和 Tree-GRPO 分数分别为 26.1%±4.21、34.2%±4.05 和 39.4%±3.87；Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B 分别为 30.3%±3.62、33.8%±3.41 和 37.2%±3.19。因此，在论文配置下，Tree-GRPO 相对 Flat GRPO 对 Qwen3.5 提高 5.2 个百分点，对 Nemotron-3 提高 3.4 个百分点。

底座实验只支持更窄的 reset 结论。fork 和 revert 作用于捕获的 copy-on-write 状态；不同 mutation size 的 sweep 报告 12/12 次检查中，revert 后工作目录与 fork 前状态一致。主基准的 fork 延迟约 134–143 ms，Mac/Docker Desktop sweep 约 340 ms。这些测量支持捕获的文件系统/沙箱回滚，不支持任意外部服务或不可逆调用都可撤销。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The contribution is not merely storing tool-call logs. Shepherd makes agent execution a manipulable value with a typed state-transition contract. Intent and outcome are distinct records, agent state and environment state fork together, and divergent continuations share a content-addressed prefix. This lets a meta-agent intervene at runtime or replay a suffix without reconstructing state from a flat transcript.

For reasoning-data construction, the key novelty is the alignment between storage and credit assignment. The branch graph retains which actions belong to the common prefix and which occur after the counterfactual choice. Tree-GRPO can therefore attach an inter-root outcome advantage to the prefix and an intra-tree sibling advantage to the suffix without training a separate value model or process-reward model. The environment trace supplies the grouping needed for localized outcome supervision.

The paper also makes rollback scope explicit. Reversible, compensable, and irreversible effects have different contracts. This prevents a common audit mistake: treating a replayable transcript as proof that the external world was restored. Shepherd is strongest when state lives inside a captured filesystem or sandboxed process tree; applications with broadly coupled or irreversible effects need additional handlers and governance.

该工作并非只是保存工具调用日志。Shepherd 把智能体执行变成具有类型化状态转移契约、可被操作的值：意图与结果分别记录，智能体状态与环境状态一起 fork，分歧 continuation 共享内容寻址的前缀。元智能体因而可以在运行时干预，或只回放后缀，而无需从扁平 transcript 重建状态。

对推理数据构造而言，关键新意在于存储结构与信用分配对齐。分支图保留哪些动作属于公共前缀、哪些动作发生在反事实选择之后。Tree-GRPO 因而能把跨根结果 advantage 赋给前缀，把树内 sibling advantage 赋给后缀，而不需要单独训练 value model 或过程奖励模型。环境轨迹直接提供局部结果监督所需的分组关系。

论文也明确了回滚范围。可逆、可补偿与不可逆 effects 具有不同契约，这避免一种常见审计错误：把可回放 transcript 当成外部世界已经恢复的证明。Shepherd 最适合状态位于已捕获文件系统或沙箱进程树中的场景；外部 effect 广泛耦合或不可逆时，还需要额外处理器与治理规则。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The paper frames all three applications as proofs of existence. It does not establish an optimal meta-agent policy, broad robustness across models and benchmarks, or that the same gains cannot be obtained with another substrate. Tree-GRPO specifically depends on a stronger Claude Opus 4.7 meta-agent for fork selection, adding token cost and a teacher-policy dependency.

Release completeness is the main data limitation. The official experiment repository contains code and a frozen framework snapshot, but no generated root/sibling trajectories, terminal rewards, exact task-ID split, random seeds, filtered-trajectory counts, trained checkpoints, or checkpoint-to-run manifest. Successful and failed siblings must coexist during advantage computation, while all-pass tasks and overlong trajectories are filtered, yet the durable retention policy and record counts are undisclosed.

Reset guarantees are tiered. Captured filesystem and sandbox state can be restored; compensable effects require correct user handlers; model calls, emails, and other irreversible effects are audit-only. Counterfactual replay also loses its efficiency advantage when an edit affects most later behavior. Overlay checkpoint chains require compaction after roughly 60 layers, and event-stream storage grows linearly.

The split prevents direct Endless Terminals training on Terminal-Bench 2.0 test tasks, but no pretraining-contamination, near-duplicate, or cross-benchmark overlap audit is reported. There is no consolidated license for source tasks, model outputs, or generated traces, and no disclosed PII/secret redaction, consent, access-control, or retention policy. These gaps block treating the experiment as an auditable public training dataset.

论文将三个应用都定位为概念验证。它没有证明元智能体策略最优、方法对大范围模型和基准稳健，也没有证明相同收益只能由 Shepherd 实现。Tree-GRPO 还依赖更强的 Claude Opus 4.7 元智能体选择 fork 点，带来 token 成本与 teacher-policy 依赖。

发布完整性是主要数据限制。官方实验仓库包含代码与冻结框架快照，但没有生成的根/sibling 轨迹、终局奖励、精确任务 ID 划分、随机种子、过滤轨迹数量、训练检查点或 checkpoint-to-run 清单。advantage 计算需要同时观察成功与失败 sibling，而 all-pass 任务和 overlong 轨迹会被过滤；但持久保留策略与记录数量均未披露。

reset 保证分层成立。捕获的文件系统与沙箱状态可以恢复；可补偿 effects 需要正确的用户处理器；模型调用、邮件等不可逆 effects 只能审计。编辑影响大多数后续行为时，反事实回放也会失去效率优势。overlay checkpoint 链约到 60 层后需要压缩，event stream 存储随事件数线性增长。

训练/测试划分避免直接用 Terminal-Bench 2.0 测试任务进行 Endless Terminals 训练，但没有报告预训练污染、近重复任务或跨基准重叠审计。源任务、模型输出和生成轨迹没有统一许可，也未披露 PII/secret 脱敏、同意、访问控制或保留政策。因此，现有实验不能被视为可审计的公共训练数据集。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Shepherd is most useful as a blueprint for collecting stateful agent supervision. A data builder can preserve typed intent/outcome pairs, environment mutations, commit ancestry, fork points, sibling suffixes, and terminal rewards in one lineage graph. That structure supports tree-based RL, counterfactual evaluation, failure localization, supervisor training, trajectory compression, and safety audits without flattening away environment state.

For RLVR, the important lesson is to keep the verifier contract separate from the substrate. Shepherd provides rollback, branching, and grouping; the task supplies the terminal outcome reward. A reusable release would therefore need both: exact task/verifier versions and a manifest that links every root and sibling to environment images, seeds, rewards, and the policy/checkpoint that generated it.

For safety work, intent interception and reversible scopes offer concrete hooks for pre-execution approval, sandbox isolation, and discard-on-failure. They are not a finished safety policy. Deployment still requires effect classification, compensation handlers, secret/PII controls, access rules, and explicit handling of irreversible external actions.

The maintained framework can support new experiments, while the frozen shepherd-experiments snapshot is the relevant paper artifact. Researchers should pin the latter for reproduction and should not infer that current early-alpha APIs reproduce the reported runs without the paper's dependencies, task versions, and missing run manifests.

Shepherd 最适合作为有状态智能体监督采集的蓝图。数据构建者可以在同一谱系图中保留类型化意图/结果对、环境修改、提交祖先关系、fork 点、sibling 后缀与终局奖励。该结构支持树式 RL、反事实评测、失败定位、监督智能体训练、轨迹压缩和安全审计，而不必抹平环境状态。

对 RLVR，关键教训是把 verifier 契约与底座分开。Shepherd 提供回滚、分支和分组，任务则提供终局结果奖励。可复用发布因此必须同时给出两者：精确任务/verifier 版本，以及把每个根与 sibling 连接到环境镜像、随机种子、奖励和生成策略/checkpoint 的清单。

对安全研究，意图拦截和可逆 scope 为执行前审批、沙箱隔离与失败后 discard 提供了具体挂钩，但它们并不是完整安全策略。部署仍需要 effect 分类、补偿处理器、secret/PII 控制、访问规则，以及对不可逆外部动作的明确处置。

维护中的框架适合开展新实验，冻结的 shepherd-experiments 快照才是论文对应 artifact。复现者应固定后者，不能在缺少论文依赖、任务版本和运行清单的情况下，推断当前 early-alpha API 会自动复现论文结果。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read the programming model first: typed tasks, intent/outcome effects, coupled scopes, and the persistent commit graph define the data object. The three consumers are runtime supervision, Counterfactual Replay Optimization, and Meta-Agent-Guided Tree-RL.
  • Read the limitations as part of the method contract: the applications are proofs of existence, a strong meta-agent adds cost, broadly coupled edits erase replay savings, and reversibility is tiered rather than universal.
  • Do not equate the framework repository with the paper run. The actively maintained shepherd-agents/shepherd repository is early alpha; shepherd-agents/shepherd-experiments freezes the paper substrate and contains framework-perf, live-intervention, cbo, mcts-rl, and trajprune, but has no GitHub Release or claimed trajectory/checkpoint release.
  • The auditable training chain is: 2,492 Endless Terminals tasks; eight base-policy screening rollouts; 442 Qwen3.5 or 530 Nemotron-3 retained tasks; batches of 16 prompts and eight root samples; 8-turn, 1,024-output-token-per-turn, 16,384-input-token caps; a Claude Opus 4.7 fork selector; outcome rewards; two-level advantages; 1,120 optimization steps; held-out Endless Terminals validation and Terminal-Bench 2.0 OOD testing. Exact task IDs, seeds, branch factor, trajectories, rewards, and checkpoints remain unavailable.

• 先读编程模型：类型化 tasks、意图/结果 effects、耦合 scopes 和持久提交图共同定义数据对象；三个消费者分别是运行时监督、Counterfactual Replay Optimization 与 Meta-Agent-Guided Tree-RL。
  • 把局限性视为方法契约的一部分：应用均为概念验证，强元智能体增加成本，广泛耦合编辑会消除回放收益，可逆性也是分层契约而非普遍保证。
  • 不要把框架仓库等同于论文运行。持续维护的 shepherd-agents/shepherd 处于 early alpha；shepherd-agents/shepherd-experiments 冻结论文底座并包含 framework-perf、live-intervention、cbo、mcts-rl 与 trajprune，但没有 GitHub Release，也未声称发布轨迹或检查点。
  • 可审计训练链为：2,492 个 Endless Terminals 任务；每任务 8 条基础策略筛选 rollout；分别保留 442 个 Qwen3.5 或 530 个 Nemotron-3 任务；每步 16 个 prompts、每 prompt 8 条根样本；8-turn、每 turn 1,024 输出 token、16,384 输入 token 上限；Claude Opus 4.7 选择 fork；结果奖励；两级 advantages；1,120 个优化 steps；held-out Endless Terminals 验证与 Terminal-Bench 2.0 分布外测试。精确任务 ID、随机种子、branch factor、轨迹、奖励和检查点仍不可得。
